outgoingImageSrc.description: Image for the outgoing scene (solid color fallback if absent).

incomingImageSrc.description: Image for the incoming scene (solid color fallback if absent).

outgoingColor.description: CSS color for the outgoing layer when no image is provided.

incomingColor.description: CSS color for the incoming layer when no image is provided.

flashColor.description: CSS color for the midpoint flash.

flashDuration.description: Duration of the midpoint flash in seconds.

maxBlur.description: Peak Gaussian blur in pixels during the depth zoom.
